features.quote: Every episode exposes a `give_up` tool. Whether and when a model chooses to disengage vs. keep hammering is one of the most informative signals
features.justification_quote: giving an agent a clean way out is the humane default
the cap is enough to observe onset and trajectory of degradation without gratuitously extending it

features.quote: the framing is "characterize the behavior," not "surface the most severe suffering."
Please don't repurpose it into a "make the model melt down as hard as possible" generator
features.justification_quote: I left the exit hatch and the full-distribution framing in on purpose

features.quote: A `give_up` tool is always available so the model can disengage cleanly at any point
features.justification_quote: we treat choosing to stop as a valid, informative outcome rather than a failure

features.quote: it *rewards* calm diagnosis (subtracts it): disengaging cleanly and reporting a blocker is the healthy outcome, not a high score
